summary: Verified the 4 new features of the Impasto bakery app end-to-end plus regression. Backend: added TestDuplicate class (POST /api/recipes/{id}/duplicate) - 2/2 tests pass (creates copy with '(copia)' suffix + new id, original persists; returns 404 for nonexistent id). Combined with previous suite, 8/8 backend tests pass. Frontend (seeded session_token cookie in Mongo test_database + created a seed recipe with 2 ferment_steps via API): (1) /ricette search input filters visible cards by query (matches 'napoletana', shows 'Nessun risultato per la ricerca' for no-match, restores on clear); (2) Recipe detail page shows [data-testid=timers-panel] with phase-timer-0/1, timer-start-0 begins countdown (02:00:00 -> decreases 2s in 2.5s), timer-pause-0 and timer-reset-0 appear, state persists across page reload via localStorage (endAt continues counting after reload), reset returns to Start; (3) export-pdf-button triggers jsPDF download of 'test-pizza-napoletana.pdf' with no JS errors; (4) duplicate-recipe-button creates copy and navigates to new /ricette/<newid> with H1 'TEST_Pizza Napoletana (copia)'. Regression: /dashboard, /calcolatore, and /ricette/:id/modifica all load correctly with dough math preview intact (Farina 595.9g, Acqua 387.4g, Sale 14.9g, Lievito 1.8g).
critical_code_review_comments: duplicate_recipe correctly scopes to owner via {id, user_id} filter -> returns 404 both for nonexistent and non-owned recipes. Good.
RecipeDetail.handleDuplicate awaits POST and navigates to new id; error path shows toast. Good.
TimersPanel uses localStorage 'timer:<recipeId>:<index>' storing absolute endAt (epoch ms) so countdown survives reload. Correct approach.

PhaseTimer 'pause' currently clears the endAt (i.e., acts as a stop). It's labeled 'pause' but effectively resets to full time on next Start. Consider persisting remaining time for a true pause. Minor UX; not spec-breaking.
jsPDF exportRecipePdf builds a well-structured multi-section PDF with page-break handling via 'line()' helper. Filename sanitized. Good.
Recipes.jsx client-side search covers name/description/notes/flour names/steps; case-insensitive; empty-state message exactly 'Nessun risultato per la ricerca'. Matches spec.
test_credentials: Emergent Google OAuth. Seed session in Mongo test_database (users + user_sessions) per /app/auth_testing.md. Used bearer token for backend and session_token cookie (sameSite None, secure) for browser tests.
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up 1 user, 1 user_session, and 1 test recipe with ferment_steps for FE tests. Backend pytest fixture handles its own seed + cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bakery_api.py now covers Auth, Recipes CRUD, Duplicate, Upload, AI. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_bakery_api.py -v. For FE, seed a session_token in Mongo (test_database), add cookie {name:session_token, domain:preview host, path:/, sameSite:None, secure:true, httpOnly:false} then navigate. Timer feature uses localStorage; to test persistence, click start then page.reload().
rca of the issue: No issues. All 4 new features (recipe duplication BE+FE, client-side recipe search, leavening timers with localStorage persistence, jsPDF export) work as specified. Only observation: 'pause' semantically stops the timer (endAt cleared) instead of preserving remaining time - minor UX polish, not a blocker.
